basic_info.description: Enjoy one of the best blocks in Bayview: Innes Court! This 1940s home is perched on a hillside at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac and enjoys views north to downtown and the Bay. The updated eat-in kitchen features new cabinetry and appliances with two pantries. The top floor has two bedrooms facing the rear garden. The dining and living rooms face north and enjoy the views. Skylights in the bath and kitchen add natural light. The ground floor includes a second bath, two bonus rooms, laundry alcove, and the garage. Step out to the garden and enjoy the warm back patio and elevated back deck for downtown and Bay views. Plenty of privacy and ample street parking for guests. Close access to Muni line 15, 54, and the T train. One block to Youngblood Coleman Park. Walking distance to Starbucks and Lucky's. Jump on this opportunity to own a single family home in SF for under $1M.
